title: The Case of the Jammed Press
story: Press night at the Gazette was going beautifully until the old press groaned, clanked and stopped dead, and Ada pulled a single red mitten out of the rollers. The press room is drafty in November, so the five helpers, on five different jobs, all worked in mittens, each pair a different color. In forty-one years Ada has fished a necktie and half a sandwich out of that press, but never a mitten. Whose mitten stopped the press?
